# 728. Self Dividing Numbers

## Solution 1 (time O(nlog(n)), space O(1))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def selfDividingNumbers(self, left, right):
        """
        :type left: int
        :type right: int
        :rtype: List[int]
        """
        ans = []
        for cur_num in range(left, right + 1):
            flag = True
            t = cur_num
            while t:
                if t % 10 == 0 or cur_num % (t % 10) != 0:
                    flag = False
                    break
                t = t // 10
            if flag:
                ans.append(cur_num)
        return ans
```
